name: preview-generated-formatting
goal: Generated managed preview launchers are excluded by both formatting entry points while authored source remains checked.

evidence: Commit 6a0c5def writes generated preview launchers under packages/reports/.cache. Root formatting skips caches, but package formatting lacks that declaration and the full check rejects 33 generated bundles.
The existing standardized format-ignore test covers only the root ignore file and old fixture outputs. Extend it to both formatter entry points, generated runtime paths and authored preview source.
Formal red c5943cb7 at 468dd3f4 proves the package formatter does not exclude generated launchers; root formatting and authored-source assertions already pass.
Declare only .cache in the package ignore file. Keep authored source checked. The existing root format-ignore test now checks both entry points in normal unit verification.
ffad359f declares only the generated .cache directory in the package formatter. The existing standardized root guard runs both formatter boundaries and preserves source inclusion.
Formal green 9947baa6 at ffad359f passes the unchanged command and complete test corpus from red e12d92df at 468dd3f4.
A clean ffad359f snapshot with only the .cache ignore removed fails the same unchanged format-ignore test. Restoring that line passes. The checkout and its source files were untouched.
